reasons: The candidate multiplies the metric by a constant 100, which is not in the Datadog source (system.load.1 is a plain load average, not a percentage), and the converter must not apply numeric constants.
The OTel metric system.cpu.load_average.1m is a gauge measuring the same 1-minute load average, so an exact translation exists and the outcome should be translated without the scale factor.
Drop the 100 factor to get avg({otel_metric_name="system.cpu.load_average.1m", otel_metric_type="gauge"}); no scope template variable is needed since its prefix is null and default is '*'.
